profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a down to earth Full Stack Engineer specialized in Frontend Development and UX Engineering. I build software to be used by real people to solve real world problems.

I firmly believe technology should be accessible to everyone and should have a positive impact on its users. The applications I create are responsive, adhere to WCAG, and are intuitive to reach the widest audience of users. Whether it's a simple green confirmation message or an awesome "You did the thing!" animation I apply best practices to ensure users enjoy their experience.

I've worked remotely for the majority of my career which has enabled me to interact with a diverse range of partners in the tech industry across the US. Consulting, transportation, additive manufacturing, shipping & logistics, and more -- my experience enables me to work language agnostic, unrestricted to any platform or system, and using a diverse range of technologies including React, Vue, AWS, and CI/CD platforms.

The tech industry is always changing and so am I. I routinely take on new certificates and engage with new technologies and concepts to adapt to the times and ensure my skills remain relevant. SPA, MVC, MVVM, Domain Driven Design, Microservices, Event Messaging -- I'm always eager to learn more and apply my knowledge to build the best.

I have a passion for bringing people together and I achieve this through my interests in Japanese Language and Culture. With my degree in Japanese Language and Literature and N2 certified fluency I am always seeking opportunities to build communities and mutual understanding.
- Active member of Torus Japanese Language Meetup & Portland Japanese Language Exchange 「ポートランド日本語交換会」
- Formerly a member of the Japan America Society of Georgia
- Graduate of Middlebury's 2017 Summer Language School for Japanese

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering SecurSpace, the Airbnb for shipping and logistics.

As a Full Stack Engineer, I've modernized SecurSpace by establishing new development guidelines, overseeing the implementation of new features, components, and maintenance 7+ year old legacy code.

I specialize in rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development, and my experience has been critical to carrying business needs to MVP to production features now core to SecurSpace. Map based search and mobile friendly image upload, are examples of AI assisted projects that I've personally delivered.

Key contributions and experience in my role include:
Leading the refactoring and migration of  a 7+ year old React application from JavaScript  to TypeScript. This was an effort to increase development speed and ease development with AI Agents.

Routinely supported sales department to meet client commitments worth over $20,000 in annual revenue.
Worked with finance department to ease accounting pain points and prevent revenue loss.

Partnered with sales and marketing department to project company brand, activity, and industry insights through HubSpot Blogs. Integrated HubSpot user tracking and custom forms resulting in actionable product analytics.

Developed and maintained REST APIs and backend services to manage high quantities of product, transaction, and user data.

Key Technologies: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Spring Boot, Java, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS, Git, HubSpot, AI-assisted development, LLM integrations
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub Copilot · React.js · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · PostgreSQL · Prompt Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Software Engineer directly responsible for developing new client facing products, integrating new and emerging technologies, and maintenance of existing full stack infrastructure.

Led the development of PrintRite3D's new Machine Health Software and Features including diagnostic tools, user accounts and authentication. Performed Competitive Audits of Metal-Fab Industry UI/UX and Feature Offerings, directly reported to C-level management. Regularly met critical deadlines, demonstrated product features directly to stakeholders and top level executives.

Led the integration of new technologies to bring Sigma up to industry standards. Introduced and managed Figma as a prototyping and team collaboration tool. Established previously non-existent frontend test framework with Mocha. Created and managed Confluence as a Documentation Base.

Led the company's pivot towards Agile development. Introduced and enforced Agile concepts such as User Stories and Acceptance Criteria. Directly managed Agile ceremonies including Backlog Refinement and Sprint Planning.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Django REST Framework · Vuetify · JavaScript · Figma (Software) · REST APIs · Vue.js · User Experience (UX) · Vue · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
July 2020 - March 2021
Lead Full Stack Engineer @ Employbridge. Responsible for architecting and leading the integration of CRM services for a new recruitment and hiring platform.

Implemented a complex Spring Boot microservice based payroll integration service that handles hundreds of thousands of worker onboarding and payroll needs. Led the integration of external Lawson PES and Novatime ERP Services for Location, Worker, and Payroll data consumption, storage, and processing.

March 2020 - July 2020
Mobile App Engineer @ Moovel Group. Maintained an Android/iOS Mobile Transit App used by over 6 million travelers monthly in several major cities across the US.

June 2019 - March 2020
Full Stack Engineer @ Chick-fil-A. Worked across the web stack to migrate CFA's core .NET based website to a new React Application. Capitalized on micro-UI Architecture to better utilize multiple internal APIs for content delivery.  Developed a backend Spring Boot API using multiple AWS services including EC2, S3, and SQS. 

Led a small team in designing a Command Line Interface for rapid new hire on-boarding. Integrated several external dependencies, designed regression tests, and introduced continuous integration and deployment via CircleCI. Reduced on-boarding time from 2 days to 15 minutes and organized on-boarding processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · REST APIs · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · React.js

positions.description: Individualized tutor sessions to foster students' understanding of Japanese. Leveraged student's personal interests in Japanese culture to motivate fun continuous language exposure.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Utilized advanced understanding of Java, Python, Data Structures, and Algorithms to evaluate the needs of and instruct over 30 students at a time by clearly defining course concepts, coding conduct, and providing the necessary scaffolding for success.

positions.description: Residential Assistant to several living complexes across Colgate University. Oversaw the safety and wellbeing for over 90 residents at a time. Individually led small teams to execute small scale programs to promote a sense of community; worked in energetic teams of 6 or more to oversee various large scale programs such as music concerts.

positions.description: General purpose use of Mac and PC operating systems to accommodate the needs of clients. Frequent use of interpersonal skills to communicate with clients and adapt to changing event circumstances. Daily use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to display and navigate presentations

honors.title: Deans List Award For Academic Excellence - Fall 2015-2018
honors.description: Semesterly Award. Maintained a GPA of above 3.3 for each semester.

projects.title: Consolidated User Feedback Application
projects.description: Part of the Sogeti-CFA Hackathon, worked in a group of 5. Created a User Feedback Application that pulled data from multiple sources (Customer feedback, emails, etc.), normalized it based on a universal format, and displayed filtered data on an internal Angular Web Application. Built from the ground up using web APIs, AWS Lambda for initiating data retrieval, and Angular and Bootstrap for frontend development.

projects.title: Food Allergens and Dietary Restrictions Full Stack Web Application
projects.description: Awarded $4,500 Grant through Colgate's Division of Natural Sciences to research and natural language processing and OCR technology. This research culminated in the development of a Ruby on Rails Web Application that provides more confidence and assurance to those who eat out but have an allergen or dietary restriction that prevents them from trying new restaurants or foods. FAD-Web App automatically crawls the web and retrieves restaurant menus, and cross references ingredients with similar online recipes using Natural Language Processing and OCR. The end result is the identification of hidden allergens and unmentioned ingredients displayed in a standardized and accessible menu format. Colgate Article Featured Here: https://news.colgate.edu/2018/07/app-etizing-research-for-those-with-dietary-restrictions.html/.
